projects.title: Construction ERP Platform
projects.summary: A full ERP web application for a Bangalore turnkey residential construction business, replacing a workflow that ran on paper and spreadsheets.
points: Modelled property, project and vendor records across an 11-stage construction lifecycle, from marking and CAD to handover, with stage-wise approvals and payment schedules.
Role-based access for admin, client, vendor, worker and site engineer.
Document management and reporting across materials, labour, expenses and payments.

projects.title: Deva Construction Website
projects.summary: The public face of the same construction business: a marketing site with a scroll-driven walkthrough hero and a project showcase the owner updates himself.
points: Built a frame pipeline that turns a rendered walkthrough into two WebP sequences (desktop and mobile) and scrubs them with scroll, so the hero plays like video without shipping one.
Project showcase reads published projects from Supabase behind row-level security, with an admin endpoint for adding new work and a proper empty state when nothing is live yet.
Contact form, services and about pages, sitemap and robots for search, and a custom domain with DNS and apex-to-www redirects set up on Vercel.

meta.label: For
meta.value: Deva Construction, live on its own domain

projects.title: AI Code Documentation System
projects.summary: An information-extraction pipeline that reads raw source files and writes the documentation a human would have skipped.
points: Parses source into structured entities (classes, functions, variables) through AST analysis, across multiple languages.
Transformer-based sequence models generate contextual natural-language summaries from the extracted structure.
Output as HTML, Markdown and PDF through a Flask interface.

meta.label: Stack
meta.value: Transformers, LLMs, Python, Flask, NLTK, AST

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction Service
projects.summary: Logistic regression benchmarked against a random forest, judged on the metric that matters for churn: recall on the customers who actually leave.
points: Evaluated on ROC-AUC and minority-class recall; threshold chosen for the business, not the default.
SHAP attribution traces each prediction back to its input features and turns the output into retention recommendations.
Containerised with Docker and deployed publicly.
